summary.text: Andy Fugate (D) represents Oklahoma House District 94 in Oklahoma City and has served since the 57th Legislature. He was Minority Floor Leader and sits on the Government Oversight, Appropriations and Budget, Rules, and Health and Human Services Oversight committees.

paragraphs.text: His House biography lists community involvement including Del City Rotary (past president), Del City Kiwanis, the Del City Chamber of Commerce, and the Oklahoma Close Up Foundation board (past chair).

It also lists service as Big Teepee District Chair for the Last Frontier Council of Scouting BSA, and as a Mid-Del Public Schools Foundation board member from 2011 to 2017, serving as president in 2016 and 2017.
